# Do your hreflang alternates actually link back?

> Free tool: paste a page's HTML (or try fetching its alternates) and check its hreflang tags for missing reciprocal links, invalid language/region codes (en-uk vs en-GB), a missing x-default, a missing self-reference, and conflicting hreflang values.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
